title: Fun!
text: Fun!. This is such a fun tumbler! It has a rainbow metallic look to it. The lid screws on easily. The texture to it makes it easy to grip. It reminds me of the cups from SB!

product_metadata.title: 24Oz Studded Matte Black Tumbler, Reusable Plastic Cup, with Lid and Straw, Studded Double Venti Cup,Water Bottle, 100% BPA Free, Insulated Cold Only, Leak Proof, Wide Mouth for Easy Cleaning (Black)

【Have A No Sweat Design】 :To Make Sure Your Hands Stay Dry Odor-free, Stain-free, Clean Tasting.
【Sof t Coating Design】New Matte Colors Have A Velvety Soft Feel,Soft Coating Design, Feel Great.
【Easy To Clean】:Wide Mouth Design for Easy Cleaning.The Lid Contains A Silicone Gasket,Insulated, Leak Proof.

【Double Layer Design】: Double-layer Design Provides The Highest Heat Insulation. The Two Layers Insulate The Cup By Forcing Heat To Transfer Through A Layer of Air and Keep Your Beverage Cold for Hours with No Condensation Rings.
